about: A1 on the Coords-free base (docs/plans/a1_nc_stage.md, N5): every layout of the nc stage's readings, per target and target date, the target block last, written in the nc layout (no Coords; DEM the only static). Blocks are MODALITY@date-index of the location's four chronological dates; a date block keeps its year. Written by eo/scripts/eval_temporal.py layouts --layout-tag nc1; frozen by its hash (eo/eval/temporal.FROZEN_LAYOUTS).

locations.target_dates: t = (i + j) % 4: location i of the n, j the target's index in (S2L2A, S1GRD, NDVI) or the layout's fixed j; forecast t = 3; the date task j = 0

probe.about: v1's probe: the target's day bin moved by 36 of 73 (about half a year), its year kept; the null moves it by one bin

baselines.rule: per group (a task, a kit task, or bar2) and target: of the candidates (role candidate, `task` naming the group), the one with the lowest mean CE on the n dev locations, read on the extended base without date blocks (reading tag `read_on`); within 0.005 nats, the shorter layout. Applied by eval_temporal report to the base's units alone, so nothing a trained checkpoint reads enters the choice
